clue.text: Worries about one finding tooth decay

indicators.note: about means going round, so the worries are wrapped around the one

parts.note: worries as a verb means cares
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone anxious about something discovers a rotten tooth.
explanation.definitionFit: Caries is the dental term for the decay that eats away teeth and bone.

clue.text: Stomach pain affected son around middle of afternoon

indicators.note: around means the camp-plus-son letters enclose the middle letter

parts.note: camp means affected, theatrically mannered

indicators.note: middle of picks the central letter of afternoon

parts.note: the fifth of nine letters in afternoon is R
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: A son gets a tummy ache halfway through the afternoon.
explanation.definitionFit: Cramps are painful muscle spasms, commonly felt in the abdomen.

clue.text: Report of gunfire and body seen during disturbance

indicators.note: seen during places the body in the middle of the disturbance

parts.note: a riot is a violent public disturbance
flesh is the body, as opposed to the spirit

explanation.surface: A news report of shooting and a corpse found in a riot.
explanation.definitionFit: A report is the loud bang of a gun, and a rifle shot makes exactly that noise.

clue.text: Detailed petition after test case

indicators.note: after puts the shortened petition behind the test

parts.note: an exam is a test

indicators.note: detailed read as de-tailed means having its tail, the last letter, cut off

parts.note: a plea is an appeal or petition

explanation.surface: A detailed appeal following a test case in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Detailed' looks like 'thorough', but read as de-tailed it removes the A from PLEA to give PLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A case can mean an instance or example of something, as in 'a case in point'.

clue.text: City Stalin destroyed British university probes

indicators.note: probes means pushes into, so the two letters are pushed into the rearranged name
destroyed means the letters of the name are wrecked and rebuilt in a new order

explanation.surface: A British university investigates a city flattened by the Soviet dictator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'destroyed' rearranges STALIN to ISTANL, and 'probes' pushes B and U into it.
explanation.definitionFit: Istanbul is the largest city in Turkey, straddling the Bosporus.

clue.text: Searching home for washing-up utensil

parts.note: scouring an area means searching it thoroughly
a pad is informal for a home or flat

explanation.surface: Hunting round the house for something to wash the dishes with.
explanation.definitionFit: A scouring pad is an abrasive pad used to scrub dirty pots and pans.

clue.text: Food from Portugal I mentioned

indicators.note: from means the answer is taken out of the run of letters across these words

explanation.surface: Someone mentions the cuisine of Portugal.
explanation.definitionFit: Aliment is a formal word for nourishment or sustenance.

clue.text: Charlie's predecessor is excellent

definitions.meaning: first meaning: in the NATO phonetic alphabet B (...) comes just before C (Charlie)
second meaning: an exclamation of approval, well done

explanation.walkthrough: Charlie looks like a person whose job passed down, but it is the radio code word for C.
explanation.definitionFit: Bravo is both the signalling code word for B and a shout of applause meaning splendid.

clue.text: Educated character ready to ignore the odds

parts.note: a letter is a written character

indicators.note: ignore the odds means drop the odd-placed letters and keep only the even ones

parts.note: the second and fourth letters of ready are E and D

explanation.surface: A learned person who is prepared to defy the betting odds.
explanation.definitionFit: Lettered means well read or learned, someone versed in literature.

clue.text: Going by article following day, papers ignored brawl

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
f is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

indicators.note: ignored means the papers are left out of the day

parts.note: Friday is a day of the week
ID stands for identity papers

explanation.surface: Someone who goes by the newspaper article and skips the papers ends up in a fight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ignored' takes ID out of FRIDAY, leaving FRAY.
explanation.definitionFit: An affray is a public fight, a disturbance of the peace in legal language.

clue.text: Principal act, name I'm backing, American books

parts.note: to do is to act or perform

indicators.note: backing means the name and I'm are read in reverse

parts.note: I'm written without the apostrophe gives IM
NT is the New Testament, a set of books of the Bible

explanation.surface: A list of items for some ceremony: the main act, a name, American books.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' turns N + IM round to MIN.
explanation.definitionFit: Dominant means chief or most influential, the leading one among others.

clue.text: Maybe cobbler ripped off legendary rat-catcher?

parts.note: a cobbler is a baked fruit dish with a topping, an example of a pie

indicators.note: off means the letters of ripped are thrown out of their order

explanation.surface: A shoemaker perhaps tore off something belonging to the famous rodent hunter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cobbler' suggests a shoemaker, but here it is the fruit dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pied Piper of Hamelin is the folk-tale figure who lured the town's rats away with his pipe.

clue.text: Superb compilers under pressure as leaders in their field

indicators.note: under in a down clue means the superb compilers sit below the pressure

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure
ace is slang for excellent or superb
crossword compilers are called setters

explanation.surface: Brilliant puzzle setters, working under stress, are at the forefront.
explanation.definitionFit: Pacesetters are those who lead the way and set the standard others follow.

clue.text: Behave theatrically, aloof right away

indicators.note: away means the right is sent off from aloof

parts.note: remote means aloof or distant in manner

explanation.surface: An actor overplays the part, then becomes standoffish straight away.
explanation.definitionFit: To emote is to show feeling in an exaggerated, stagey manner.

clue.text: Cook scans food to welcome Italy's top police officer

indicators.note: to welcome means take in, so the cook-scans-food letters hold Italy inside

parts.note: a chef is a cook
I is the international vehicle code for Italy
to con a text is to study or scan it
table can mean the food served, as in keeping a good table

explanation.surface: A chef studies the menu as he receives an Italian dignitary.
explanation.walkthrough: To con is an old verb meaning to study a text closely, which is how 'scans' works here; 'food' as table is the sense in 'keeps a good table'.
explanation.definitionFit: A chief constable heads a British police force, the highest rank in it.

clue.text: Overload electrical circuit and become enraged

definitions.meaning: first meaning: too much current melts the fuse wire
second meaning: an idiom for losing one's temper

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a sudden loss of temper, borrowed from the wire that melts when a circuit is overloaded.

clue.text: Small insect that is circling round drink

indicators.note: circling means the insect goes round the round letter

parts.note: a moth is an insect
O is round in shape
i.e. is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A tiny bug buzzes round a beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: A smoothie is a thick blended drink of fruit and yoghurt or milk.

clue.text: Dam lake, the one sisters look up to?

definitions.text: the one sisters look up to?

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse
Lake Superior is one of the Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A dam and a lake suggest engineering, then a question about a revered figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dam' looks like a water barrier beside 'lake', but it is an animal's mother.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mother Superior heads a convent, so the nuns she leads defer to her.

clue.text: Peer with sidearm at intervals previously

parts.note: an earl is a peer of the realm

indicators.note: at intervals means taking every other letter

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters of sidearm are I, E, R

explanation.surface: A nobleman carrying a pistol in days gone by.
explanation.definitionFit: Earlier as an adverb means at a previous time, before now.

clue.text: Vehicle manufacturer, learn it is in trouble

indicators.note: in trouble means the letters are in disorder and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A carmaker is in difficulties and needs to learn a lesson.
explanation.walkthrough: Reliant was a British car maker, famous for the three-wheeled Robin.
explanation.definitionFit: Reliant Motors built small cars and vans in England, notably three-wheelers.

clue.text: Great number in district demanding change of leader

indicators.note: change of leader means the first letter of district is swapped for another

parts.note: a region is a district or area

explanation.surface: Many people in an area are calling for a new head.
explanation.walkthrough: The new first letter is not clued; the definition fixes it as L.
explanation.definitionFit: A legion is a vast host, as in 'their name is legion', meaning very many.

clue.text: Discovered treasure-chests being put up for sale

indicators.note: discovered read as dis-covered means stripped of its outer letters

parts.note: coffers are strong boxes for valuables

explanation.surface: Treasure found in chests is put on the market.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Discovered' looks like 'found', but read as un-covered it takes the end letters off COFFERS.
explanation.definitionFit: To offer goods is to make them available for purchase.

clue.text: Actor Will, said to be wild

indicators.note: said means the actor's surname is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: Will Ferrell is an American comic actor

explanation.surface: A film star is reported to be untamed.
explanation.definitionFit: Feral describes an animal that has gone back to a natural, untamed state.

clue.text: Tsunami we validate mostly at sea

indicators.note: at sea means confused, so the letters are rearranged
mostly means validate loses its last letter

explanation.surface: We confirm that a giant wave is mostly happening offshore.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' cuts VALIDATE to VALIDAT; 'at sea' rearranges it with WE.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal wave is the popular name for a huge sea wave caused by an earthquake.

clue.text: Courageous women in hospital attending older European revolutionary

indicators.note: attending means accompanying, so the hospital is placed beside the rest

parts.note: H is the map abbreviation for hospital

indicators.note: revolutionary means turning round, so older plus European is read backwards

parts.note: senior means older

explanation.surface: Brave nurses in a hospital look after an elderly European rebel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like a noun for a rebel but turns SENIORE round to EROINES.
explanation.definitionFit: Heroines are women admired for bravery or noble deeds.

clue.text: Dog William's regularly taken westwards across country

indicators.note: across means the reversed letters stretch over the country
in an across clue westwards is right to left, so the letters are reversed
regularly means taking every second letter

parts.note: the even letters of William's are I, L, A, S
UK is the United Kingdom

explanation.surface: William takes his dog on a trip westward across the land.
explanation.walkthrough: In an across clue, 'westwards' means right to left, which is why it signals reading the picked letters backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The saluki is a slender Middle Eastern hunting hound.

clue.text: Plant, the result of incredible largesse

indicators.note: incredible means unbelievable, so the letters are not to be trusted in their order

explanation.surface: A plant grown thanks to amazing generosity.
explanation.definitionFit: Eelgrass is a grass-like flowering plant that grows underwater in shallow seas.

clue.text: Scattered in all directions, hollow timber

indicators.note: in puts the emptied timber inside the compass points

parts.note: the four compass points S, E, W and N, here in the order the answer needs

indicators.note: hollow means the inside of timber is removed, leaving its outer letters

parts.note: the first and last letters of timber are T and R

explanation.surface: Wood lies scattered everywhere, its inside rotted away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in all directions' looks like part of the definition, but the four compass points supply the outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Strewn means spread untidily over a surface.
